statement: A single Russian attack on one Ukrainian settlement kills at least 20 people between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-22.
resolution: Ukrainian national or regional officials report 20 or more deaths from one Russian attack on one settlement occurring between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-22, and at least two of Reuters, AP and BBC carry that toll.
failure_condition: No single Russian attack on a Ukrainian settlement between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-22 kills 20 or more people.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin meet in person at least once between 2026-10-12 and 2026-12-31.

failure_condition: Trump and Putin do not meet face to face at any time between 2026-10-12 and 2026-12-31.
